ei.title: A Rooftop Garden in Sejong City

fullPassage: In the city, where people and buildings crowd together, much of the land is covered in concrete. In this urban landscape, rooftop gardens provide a natural oasis. These gardens are for cultivating plants on building roofs, and they offer numerous benefits. They help reduce energy consumption for heating and cooling. They also clean the air because their plants give off oxygen and absorb air pollutants. One remarkable example of a rooftop garden is found at the Government Complex Sejong, which has been officially recognized as the largest of its kind. It has a span of 3.6 km and covers an area of 79,194 m², spread across fifteen connected buildings. The ground is covered in basalt, creating a natural drainage effect. In the garden, speakers for announcements are made to look like rocks to complement the plants, creating a beautiful atmosphere. It also possesses an impressive variety of flowers, with a total of 192 different plant species. The beauty of the rooftop garden changes with each passing season, presenting visitors with seasonal flowers and plants, and captivating views to enjoy. The place is free to visit, and everyone is welcome to enjoy the beautiful landscape and aesthetic spectacle of Sejong City from above.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

❌ ② covered: 수동태 is covered 적절.
✅ ③ provides → provide: 복수주어 gardens + 복수동사 provide. ←정답
❌ ④ cultivating: 전치사 for + 동명사 적절.
det.tip: 주어-동사 수일치: 복수주어(gardens) → 복수동사(provide). -s 불필요.

✅ ② recognizing → recognized: has been + p.p. 수동태 구문. ←정답
❌ ③ covers: 3인칭 단수(It) + covers 적절.
❌ ④ spread: 과거분사 분사구문(퍼져 있는 상태) 적절.
